rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining suppressed below the 5-minute 9-EMA on light bounce volume, which has just been invalidated by the latest 1-minute candle surging from $48.89 to $49.24 on a sharp volume expansion (15,348 shares vs. ~2,200-3,600 on prior bars). With the current price ($49.20) now firmly above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($49.05) and the bid-ask spread wide at 32.5 bps ($49.12 x $49.28), exiting proactively via a passive-first close avoids taking a market order cross into a wide spread if the nearby $49.35 invalidation triggers.
